nas100.name: Nasdaq 100
nas100.priority_contract: Run unchanged D04_A1 earliest-per-seed selection first; retain EARLIER only. ORIGINAL wins ties and can consume the seed.
nas100.description: A first breakout above the prior daily high fails below its seed-day floor. Within eight H1 bars, the first rebound probes B − 0.25 × failure ATR and closes below it, with the preceding close below the zone. Candle colour is not a filter.
nas100.limitation: Seven archived entries. The subgroup was identified after inspecting 2026; independent validation is pending.

cac40.name: CAC 40
cac40.priority_contract: Unchanged H01 comparator reservations, daily-breach consumption and post-defense closing guard.
cac40.description: BUY and SELL mirror each other. Require a breach at least one pre-breach ATR deep, reclaim within 24 H1 bars, bounded defense within eight bars and resumption within four. Preserve the original guarded defense and reservation logic.
cac40.limitation: Eight archived entries; none in October–November. Independent validation is pending.

jpn225.name: Nikkei 225
jpn225.formation: Weekly context → first daily-high breakout → acceptance
jpn225.priority_contract: Run Combined_BASE earliest-per-seed selection with original C1/F1W4/F1_PRICE/R4 priority; retain F1W4 only.
jpn225.description: The reference daily close is above the preceding four completed weekly highs. A first intraday close breaks the previous daily high, and the next whole H1 range holds above it. Preserve the Combined seed and priority rules.
jpn225.limitation: All eight archived entries occurred in January–June. Later recurrence and independent validation remain unproven.

aus200.name: Australia 200
aus200.formation: Daily-high breakout → floor failure → SELL acceptance
aus200.priority_contract: Unchanged D04_BASE earliest original/early event per seed; ORIGINAL wins ties.
aus200.description: After an initial daily-high breakout, require a close below the seed-day floor within 24 H1 bars. Confirm with the next whole H1 bar below the floor, or the first eligible rejected retest of B − 0.5 × failure ATR within eight bars.
aus200.limitation: Twelve archived SELL entries. BUY continuation is not part of this candidate; independent validation is pending.

management.BE: Two consecutive completed eligible H1 closes at least +1 ATR; guarded activation at the next eligible M1 opening.
management.costs: Recorded entry/exit spread proxy and adverse opening gaps; not a bid/ask tick-fill simulation.
management.censoring: A full 24-native-H1 horizon is required for a final score; a provisional target/stop touch remains unscored until then.
management.ATR_anchor: H01: pre-breach ATR. D04/F1W4: completed signal H1 ATR.
management.entry: First confirmed native M15 open at or after signal close; 15-minute publication can observe the entry later.
management.status: Research candidates. No broker orders. No independent 2024–2025 validation completed.
